g.text: The globe has to breathe: an ePTFE vent, a weep path and a coated board are the defences; U4 is how anyone knows they work. See moistlab/boards/orb_climate.py.

g.desc: The globe has to breathe: an ePTFE vent, a weep path and a coated board are the defences; U4 is how anyone knows they work. See moistlab/boards/orb_climate.py.

g.text: 16 pixels, ONE chain. WLED's four "segments" are software divisions of this single chain — one per sphere — not four wires.

g.desc: 16 pixels, ONE chain. WLED's four "segments" are software divisions of this single chain — one per sphere — not four wires.

g.text: TWO white channels: 2200 K on U1 and 3000 K on U3, 5s each at 0.15 A. Same ten emitters and the same 4.80 W the single channel drew — what the second driver buys is colour temperature, not light.

g.desc: TWO white channels: 2200 K on U1 and 3000 K on U3, 5s each at 0.15 A. Same ten emitters and the same 4.80 W the single channel drew — what the second driver buys is colour temperature, not light.

g.text: Each white string is 5s at 3.2 V worst-bin Vf = 16 V, plus 0.6 V driver headroom, under the 20 V bus floor.

g.desc: Each white string is 5s at 3.2 V worst-bin Vf = 16 V, plus 0.6 V driver headroom, under the 20 V bus floor.

g.text: The 5 V buck is PER DISC on purpose: a base-fed 5 V rail loses a fifth of itself in the riser before the first frame.

g.desc: The 5 V buck is PER DISC on purpose: a base-fed 5 V rail loses a fifth of itself in the riser before the first frame.

g.text: Per disc [I]: white 4.80 W at the LEDs, pixels 5.12 W at the ring, 11.67 W at the bus after 85% conversion. Four discs + base = 48.6 W per post.

g.desc: Per disc [I]: white 4.80 W at the LEDs, pixels 5.12 W at the ring, 11.67 W at the bus after 85% conversion. Four discs + base = 48.6 W per post.

g.text: Pin numbers are hidden on parts whose package pinout has NOT been transcribed. Only the 74AHCT125 shows its numbers.

g.desc: Pin numbers are hidden on parts whose package pinout has NOT been transcribed. Only the 74AHCT125 shows its numbers.
